scope: QA independent review of S7b3 (flag variant matrix + AA image-level): own pinned-3.15 re-capture per variant, own harness renders and raw-bit dumps, per-variant RGB/depth/seg comparison, independent AA semantics (first-pass depth/seg, average RGB) via per-sample renders, independent AA ray-layout re-derivation, synthetic vertex-normal discrimination replication, A-prime gate facts for megakernel and aa_resolve, rejection surface, S7b2 assertion upgrade verification, evidence integrity and diff scope, delivered suites and fmt/clippy/unit gates rerun. Fast-loop scope; no full G01; no product/fixture/original-evidence changes.

method.harness: target/qa-s7b3-harness (QA crate, product path dependency + cuda-probe; own decoding; does not include tests/support/**)
method.reference: target/qa-s7b3/capture_qa.py (pinned venv; PARAMS_28 only variant override, use_fast_math=False; QA computes every comparison itself)

variants.note: product vs QA's own pinned-3.15 re-capture; deliverable criterion <=1 LSB RGB / <=4 ULP depth / seg equality; product reached 0/0/0

aa.upstream_semantics: store_pixel aa branch accumulates color*255; _aa_resolve averages with inv_n then clamps/packs; depth/seg only written when ray_base == 0 (pinned render.py)

ray_layout.base: index=[camera][row][column], px=x, py=y, img=(w,h); recovered-coordinate bad count 0/120000
ray_layout.aa2: index=[sample][camera][row][column], px=x*spp+sample%spp, py=y*spp+sample//spp, img=(w*spp,h*spp); bad count 0/480000 across 2 cameras x 4 samples

synthetic_vertex_normals.evidence_strength: branch reachability only; no pinned reference exists for synthetic mesh normals

f64_lines.note: only the two W15 whitelist globals plus one sin/cos reduction triple in the megakernel; aa_resolve has only the included W15 globals
